messages:
soph: quick FYI 1 new hire Amina R's background screen flagged an address mismatch. start date Fri AM. do we want to hold onboarding or proceed with remote provisional?
raj (recruiter): candidate says she moved last month and is temporarily staying with a friend. can get a bank stmt or lease page tomorrow morning. prefers to keep Fri start.
ivy (onboarding): we can run remote I-9 via certified agent if she provides gov ID + a proof of address within 60 days. propose provisional onboarding Fri 9am (intro + benefits) but mark as optional and restrict access until verification complete.
matt (it): we can stage a laptop and ship to the temporary address (friend/hotel) but need candidate confirmation email with full name + delivery address + contact phone and signature. no PO boxes. shipment held until we confirm.
sec-team: security note: if you grant provisional access, do NOT enable VPN/SSO or production data access. limited test accounts only. we'll flag the account for priority final verification.
raj (recruiter): asked candidate for driver's license front/back and a PDF of bank stmt or lease. she sent license pics at 1823456900 and said she can email the lease by 1823460000.
ivy (onboarding): sending the provisional invite now: "Welcome & Benefits (Provisional)" Fri 9am. added I-9 checklist link: https://redwood.example/onboard/i9?hire=AminaR
onboard-bot: Reminder created: "Amina R docs follow-up" scheduled 1823539200.
soph: summary: keep Fri 9am optional, require docs by Fri 11am for full clearance; stage laptop and hold shipment until written delivery confirmation; create limited test account if needed. action: raj - collect docs and confirm mailing address; matt - stage laptop; ivy - send provisional invite and i-9 instructions; sec-team - standby for final check. any objections? :thumbsup:
raj (recruiter): :thumbsup: updating candidate now. will post when lease received.
ivy (onboarding): thanks all, i'll add notes to the hire packet and set a calendar reminder for final verification at 1823539200.
matt (it): staging laptop now. awaiting ship go/no-go.
sec-team: acknowledged. will approve final access once docs verified.
